name: Dorogawa Onsen Town
description: A traditional hot-spring town deep in southern Nara's sacred mountains, with ryokan, mountain spring water, local food, and a spiritual Shugendo atmosphere. The town is one slow-travel proposition rather than separate lodging cards.

en.name: Dorogawa Onsen Town
en.description: A traditional hot-spring town deep in southern Nara's sacred mountains, with ryokan, mountain spring water, local food, and a spiritual Shugendo atmosphere. The town is one slow-travel proposition rather than separate lodging cards.
en.notes: Official Nara guidance describes Dorogawa as a sacred mountain retreat and recommends combining it with nearby valley and temple experiences. Respect local residents and check facility-specific bathing rules.
en.reservation: Ryokan stays and bathing facilities have their own rules and availability; check the current official lodging/facility guidance.
en.parking: Use designated town parking and current local signs. Public transport requires Kintetsu to Shimoichiguchi followed by the local bus corridor.
en.openingHours: Hours and closures vary by date; check the official visitor guidance before visiting.

ja.name: 洞川温泉街
ja.description: 南奈良の聖なる山々に抱かれた温泉街で、旅館、山の湧水、郷土料理、修験道の精神文化を感じるそぞろ歩きを一つの滞在型体験として楽しめます。
highlights: 伝統的な温泉街の町並み
旅館の入浴と郷土料理
ja.notes: 奈良県の公式観光案内は洞川を山岳信仰の温泉地として紹介し、周辺の渓谷や寺院との組み合わせを案内しています。施設ごとの入浴案内をご確認ください。
ja.reservation: 予約・入場条件は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.parking: 駐車場・アクセス条件は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.openingHours: 開館時間・休館日は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
